properties.label: Field
properties.description: The gesture this light field draws, as the Show Composer writes it: the function (pulse, wave, ripple, expansion, sweep, chase, spiral, flow, fade, gradient, decay, echo), its origin on the stage (ox, oy, 0-1), speed (stage units a second), front width, duration and envelope, the figure's place on the stage (m) and the lights it may or may not light (only, skip; xLights' light numbers). Every model that shares the same field and start shows one movement across them.

properties.label: Intensity
properties.description: How bright the field is on this model, as a percentage of what the field gives.
